occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inception it was observed that the operation had not repaired the surface of the volleyball court that was in use and the there was trash on the ground in the play areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At the time of the inspection there was one drain cover missing in the play area and a hole in a tree stump.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough of the operation, it was observed that a speaker was left on a rolling cart that was accessible to children. The speaker was not anchored or secured to the cart, creating a safety hazard. This deficiency is being cited because the issue was not corrected following the previous inspection conducted on 3/31/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: Based on the investigation findings, a child was injured on the tennis court playing football.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: Based on findings from the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not inspect the tennis court which had damages before allowing children to play on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: During the investigation, it was demined that the operation did not complete an incident report for an injured child.
